feed.subtitle: Announcements from the jss-lint / jsslintr project — an independent style checker for Journal of Statistical Software manuscripts (not affiliated with JSS).

entry.title: jsslintr: check JSS manuscript style from R (and everywhere else)
entry.summary: jsslintr, now on CRAN, checks JSS-format manuscripts (.tex/.Rnw/.Rmd + .bib) against 62 deterministic rules with measured precision (97.2%) and recall (80.7%) — also available as a CLI, Python package, VS Code extension, GitHub Action, and a fully client-side browser app. Independent project, not affiliated with JSS.
